; eraser-end-uses-eraser-tool: the back of the Marker (eraser end) erases with the
; settings chosen in the toolbar's Eraser tool (eraser type and size), instead of
; xochitl's fixed default (normal eraser, medium size).
;
; In DeviceSceneView.qml the pen input handler hard-codes
;   eraserThickness: calculateEraserThickness(2.4) / root.penScale
; and never sets eraserTool. This binds both to the Eraser tool's settings, using the
; same thickness formula xochitl uses for the toolbar eraser.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > ScenePenInputHandler#strokeHandler
        REPLACE eraserThickness WITH {
            eraserThickness: calculateEraserThickness(documentViewTools.eraserPen && documentViewTools.eraserPen.thickness > 0
                                                      ? documentViewTools.eraserPen.thickness : 2.4) / root.penScale
            eraserTool: documentViewTools.eraserPen ? documentViewTools.eraserPen.tool : Line.Eraser
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
